{{TAGDEF|VDW_SR|[real]}}

Description: {{TAG|VDW_SR}} sets a parameter in the damping function of van der Waals methods.
----
{{TAG|VDW_SR}} allows to set the value of a parameter in the following methods:
*Radii scaling <math>s_{r,6}</math> in the dipole-dipole zero-damping function of DFT-D3. {{TAG|VDW_SR}} can be used for both implementations of DFT-D3: [[DFT-D3]] ({{TAG|IVDW}}=11) and [[simple-DFT-D3]] ({{TAG|IVDW}}=15 with {{TAG|SDFTD3_DAMPING}}=zero or mzero).
*Radii scaling <math>s_{R}</math> in the damping function of the Tkatchenko-Scheffler methods ({{TAG|IVDW}}=2 and 21).
*Radii scaling <math>\beta</math> in the damping function of the many-body dispersion energy methods ({{TAG|IVDW}}=202 and 263).
*TT-damping factor <math>b_0</math> in [[DDsC_dispersion_correction|DDsC]] ({{TAG|IVDW}}=4).
